question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**endangered**" means at serious risk of extinction. (लुप्तप्राय)
 
• In the context of the sentence, **"critically endangered" **correctly describes the status of Irrawaddy Dolphins.
 
• The other options: "**screened**," "**sheltered**," and "**ventured**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Indulge in a leisurely boat ride to visit the many spots that the vast expanse of the lake encompasses - the beacon island, bird island to name a few and of course watch the migratory birds and the critically endangered__ Irrawaddy Dolphins frolic in the prey laden brackish waters.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Screened (जाँचना)**: means to examine methodically.
 
• **Sheltered (आश्रय देना)**: means to protect or shield from harm or danger.
 
• **Ventured (साहस करना)**: means to undertake a risky or daring journey or course of action.
